result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by giving Licensee a 30-day written-notice convenience right and requiring a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, while granting Licensor no corresponding convenience right. However, permitting termination “in whole or in part” adds an unnecessary partial-termination right, and “other liability” is potentially broad enough to affect accrued or unrelated obligations. Partial termination and its refund mechanics are also undefined. The margin comment inaccurately references change-of-control and wind-up rights that do not appear in the supplied clause.
